Adolion: Between the Roads
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
A Challenge at Victory's Tusk
The scene is calm.
About this story
A week in Aegis City between adventures. The Adventurer's Guild has started to notice your party, and the C-rank promotion exam is coming due: before it there are errands to run, gear to buy, favours to carry across the city and long nights in its taverns. Expect warm, busy slice-of-life days with rivals and odd neighbours, and a real test at the end of the week. Bring the adventurer you have been so far, travelling with Belle and Dalan.
Recently
You left Bedding for the Orphanage behind and moved into A Challenge at Victory's Tusk.
At Victory's Tusk, Max Nightriver surveyed the crowded tavern while Belle pointed out a centaur adventurer and a kitsune bard as potential sources of coin and rumors. The evening wore on with drinking songs and a brawl, the barmaid quietly protecting the good tankards. The scene carried a lively, opportunistic tone.
Open threads
Kass's five-silver bet on Belle stands, with the hall's reaction still to be seen.
Kass's rumour of a C-rank posting about to drop for a party of the party's reputation.
Thorrin the centaur's fire-breathing cave story from the Velniran Peaks remains an unclaimed lead.
Naomi Moonlight and Belle's duel is now joined by Kashina as Naomi's second, with the hall watching and Kass's five-silver bet riding on it.
Yrelra, the shy blue-haired woman watching the party from the shadows, has been pointed out by Kass but not yet approached.
The story so far
The Guild offered Max Nightriver, Belle, and Dalan a C-rank promotion exam, which Domas explained would consist of an interview with Ellie, a week of preparation, and a graded quest under a Guild-appointed observer, graded as pass, pass with honours, or fail. Max signed the forms alongside Belle and Dalan. Seeking real magic in the Market District, the party was directed by Kaianalor Wrightsteel to The Velvet Shadow, a shop run by the tiefling Valerius selling unrecorded magic and cursed artifacts.
